long: Earth 2150: Escape from the Blue Planet is a fully 3D real-time strategy game continuing the war between the Eurasian Dynasty, the United Civilized States and the Lunar Corporation as they race to evacuate a doomed Earth. It features dynamic terrain deformation, day/night cycles and persistent unit and research progress carried between missions. Runs through Proton; note that the campaign FMV cutscenes do not render under this setup.
